fusions.name: Samara Spiral
fusions.desc: Spins a winged seed into one enemy for 4 damage. It then glides on to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that damage.

fusions.name: Leafwing Gust
fusions.desc: A wingbeat drives sharp leaves down a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 11 damage and knocking each enemy back 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave it [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Thistledown Drift
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds, with 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Seed on the Wind
fusions.desc: Every few paces you travel, you regain 2 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
